description: This file defines the TestDB package, which extends a test database class and provides methods for executing test data, managing transactions with rollback, and performing upgrade checks. It includes class methods for initializing and manipulating test databases, primarily used in testing scenarios for database schema and data validation.

classes.name: TestDB
classes.description: A Perl package for testing database interactions, extending a base test database class with additional utility methods for setup, data execution, transaction management, and upgrades.

methods.name: new
methods.description: Initializes a new test database schema, optionally deploying test data from a SQL file.

methods.name: execute_test_data
methods.description: Executes SQL statements from a specified file or default 'share/test_data.sql' to populate the test database.

methods.name: install_ok
methods.description: Checks if a specific database schema installation is successful, optionally verifying a version and name.

methods.name: txn_do_and_rollback
methods.description: Executes a code block within a transaction that is always rolled back afterward, useful for testing modifications without affecting the database state.

methods.name: upgrade_ok
methods.description: Verifies that the database schema can be upgraded to a specified version successfully.
